## Description
The Global Marine Weather queries global marine meteorological data by geographic coordinates, covering core navigation-critical weather indicators including sea level pressure, pressure-driven current direction, wind direction, wind speed, significant wave height, visibility, etc.

Note: Meteorological monitoring data is incomplete in certain regions. A return value of -32767 for fields such as barometric pressure and swell height indicates no valid meteorological readings are av

info.name: 5.2.2 Query Single Tide Gauge Station Details

params.name: key
params.description: Your personal Shipfinderer API key to verify service permissions

params.name: port_code
params.description: Unique ID of the port tide gauge station

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date for tidal data query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Historical data queries are supported from 2020 onwards.

params.name: end_date
params.description:
End date for tidal data query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. 
Notes:
1. Single query time range shall not exceed 90 days.
2. Forecast data is limited to 30 days in advance; requests beyond this range will return an error.
3. Historical tidal data is available for all dates from 2020 onwards.
4. Tidal data is updated once daily.
5. Future timestamps return forecast data; historical timestamps are overwritten with observed tidal data.
